<!DOCTYPE>
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">

<head>
    <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">
    <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
</head>

<body
    style="width: 384px; margin: 0 auto; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color:black;">
    <style type="text/css">
        html {
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 42px;
        }

        h2 {
            font-size: 36px;
        }

        h3 {
            font-size: 32px;
        }

        p {
            font-size: 28px;
            line-height: 1.3;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        p.small {
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        p.smaller {
            font-size: 21px;
        }

        p.smallest {
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        p.smallSmaller {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        hr {
            border: solid #000;
            border-width: 5px 0 0;
        }

        hr.BoldLine {
            border-width: 10px 0 0;
        }

        hr.dashed {
            border-style: dashed;
        }

        hr.handyspace {
            border: none;
            height: 4px;
            flex-basis: 100%;
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .bold {
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .h2 {
            font-size: 36px;
        }

        .container {
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-flow: row wrap;
        }

        .colwrapper {
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-flow: row wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .half {
            flex-basis: 50%;
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .full {
            flex-basis: 100%;
            margin: 6px 0;
        }

        .flex60 {
            flex-basis: 60%;
        }

        .flex30 {
            flex-basis: 30%;
        }

        .flex10 {
            flex-basis: 10%;
        }

        .alignright {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .aligncenter {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .textTop {
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

        .amount {
            display: inline-block;
            border-bottom: 10px double black;
            padding-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .amountTop {
            display: inline-block;
            border-top: 5px solid black;
            padding-top: 2px;
        }

        .underLine {
            display: inline-block;
            border-bottom: 4px solid black;
            padding-bottom: 2px;
        }
    </style>
    <div class="container" style="background: white; width: 384px;">
        <div class="full aligncenter">
            <p class="small">Reprint</p>
        </div>
        <div class="full aligncenter">
            <p class="small">Patron ID & Tier / 會員編號及等級</p>
            <div class="full"><img src='data:image/png;base64,
    ' width="100%" height="auto" /></div>
            <p>10000000</p>
        </div>
        <h3 class="full aligncenter">XXXXXXXXXXXX</h3>
        <hr class="handyspace" style="height: 30px">
        <h2 class="full aligncenter">eWallet receipt</h2>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">Outlet / 商戶 :</p>
            <p class="alignright">Venetian</p>
            <p>Red Dragon (SASML101)</p>
            <p></p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">POS Check No. / 帳單號 :</p>
            <p class="alignright">123456</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">Payment Type / 交易種類 :</p>
            <p class="alignright">Redeemed</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="colwrapper">
            <p class="smallest">Sales Total / 總額 :</p>
            <p class="alignright smallest">$1,000.00</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">Sands Rewards Points<br>積分</p>
            <p class="alignright">$10</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full BoldLine">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="h3">eWallet Payment Total<br>支付總額</p>
            <div class="alignright">
                <h1 class="amount">$10</h1>
            </div>
        </div>
        <hr class="full BoldLine">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">Remaining / 餘額 :</p>
            <p class="alignright">$990.00</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <div class="full">
            <p class="small">Created Date / 交易時間 :</p>
            <p class="alignright">2025/03/18 16:28:08</p>
            <p class="alignright small">seng.kou</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="full">
        <hr class="handyspace" style="height: 30px">
        <div class="full aligncenter">
            <p>Payment ID / 交易編號</p>
            <div class="full"><img src='data:image/png;base64,
    ' width="100%" height="auto" /></div>
            <p>11488</p>
        </div>
        <hr class="handyspace" style="height: 100px">
    </div>
</body>

</html>
